title: Morning Brief
summary: The client onboarding backend and form are done; password access and the Supabase link-up are still open, and onboarding questions should trigger automatic referrals as the client count grows. For Black Friday the MAIA offer becomes buy two, get three gifts (Nattokinase, K2D3 and tart cherry, adding magnesium on three), using the 75,000 K2D3 units in stock, then reverts afterwards.
points: Onboarding answers (US LLC, payment processing, margins) should route clients to the right referral automatically
Video editors are found through Instagram outreach; a style document and template message will speed testing
Black Friday needs a new hero image and banner so the offer looks new on the product page
AVIA: two strong creative strategists (Aaron Tan, Thomas) under test; Luis and Denis Kim considered for Haskap
Cash pressure is returning, so hiring decisions need to move quickly
Long-form content and Reels should run on a set weekly slot and calendar, quality first
decisions: Black Friday: buy two, get three gifts; return to the original offer right after
Add K2D3 to the gift mix
